name: Viewer warnings
responsibility: Places the warning mark a viewer adds to each subject that the code check warns about
description: The picture never holds the warning, because a picture is drawn from the picture alone. The mark stands where the picture puts it on a subject nobody has decided: the top-right corner of a part's body, the leading edge of a relationship's or a message's words, or the middle of the longest straight run of a line that has none. It goes into the subject's own group, so it recedes and ghosts with the subject.

outgoing.label: the warning mark on a warned subject
